svg.title: Dsv4 attention full dataflow
svg.text: Attention-layer dataflow (shared by CSA and HCA)
Per-channel weights; learned positional bias B
CSA adds sparse selection; HCA skips directly to concatenation

g.text: Index keys: m× compression; scoring domain 4× smaller

svg.text: → FP4 for the full QK path

g.text: Concat → KV set for this attention step

svg.text: Why a window? Causal queries can only see earlier complete compressed blocks,
so the window restores recent details from the query's own block.

g.text: Shared-KV MQA: entries serve as both keys and values
Values carry absolute positions; cancel them for relative positions.
m=4; overlapping streams; indexer selects top-1024
m′=128; single stream; dense over all entries

svg.text: Pro: 61 layers; first 2 HCA, then alternate. Both include a window and attention sink.
KV layout: compressed entries in KV Cache (block = lcm(4,128) = 128 original tokens);
window KV and uncompressed tails in State Cache, with independent eviction.
